mapper.insert: INSERT INTO care_diary (pet_id, author_member_id, diary_date, content) VALUES (#{petId}, #{authorMemberId}, #{diaryDate}, #{content})
INSERT INTO care_diary_image (diary_id, image_url, sort_order) VALUES (#{diaryId}, #{imageUrl}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT d.diary_id AS diaryId, d.pet_id AS petId, d.author_member_id AS authorMemberId, m.name AS authorName, d.diary_date AS diaryDate, d.content AS content, d.visibility AS visibility, d.hidden_by_report_at AS hiddenByReportAt, d.created_at AS createdAt, d.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM care_diary d JOIN member m ON m.member_id = d.author_member_id WHERE d.pet_id = #{petId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(d.diary_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} ORDER BY d.diary_date DESC, d.diary_id DESC

SELECT d.diary_id AS diaryId, d.pet_id AS petId, d.author_member_id AS authorMemberId, m.name AS authorName, d.diary_date AS diaryDate, d.content AS content, d.version AS version, d.visibility AS visibility, d.hidden_by_report_at AS hiddenByReportAt, d.created_at AS createdAt, d.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM care_diary d JOIN member m ON m.member_id = d.author_member_id WHERE d.diary_id = #{diaryId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update:
UPDATE care_diary SET diary_date = #{diaryDate}, content = #{content}, version = version + 1 WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT image_id AS imageId, image_url AS imageUrl, public_image_key AS publicImageKey FROM care_diary_image WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} ORDER BY image_id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO diary_report (diary_id, reporter_id, reason) VALUES (#{diaryId}, #{reporterId}, #{reason})
mapper.update: UPDATE diary_report SET inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
UPDATE care_diary SET hidden_by_report_at = NOW() WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND hidden_by_report_at IS NULL
UPDATE care_diary SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
